name: Kōya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōya town emblem in navy: a disc with a white ring and a stylised device, like a monk's figure.
history: Municipal flag of Kōya, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1962.

features.role: Kōya town emblem — a disc with a white ring and a stylised device, like a monk's figure
